title: Observability: pool-exhausted message fires on post-cleanup access — misleading diagnosis
description: After wc_crypto2dev_cleanup(), g_pool.slots is set to NULL. crypto2dev_pool_acquire() returns -1 when pool->slots == NULL (line 300). The callers (crypto2dev_cipher:702, crypto2dev_hash:957, crypto2dev_hmac:1155) all log 'pool exhausted — increase WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_POOL_SIZE'. A support engineer diagnosing WC_HW_E after a cleanup-while-in-flight scenario sees 'pool exhausted' and spends time increasing pool size and recompiling rather than identifying that cleanup() was called while objects were still live. The two conditions (pool full vs. pool destroyed) are indistinguishable from the log. Fix: distinguish the post-cleanup case (slots == NULL) from the pool-full case (all slots in_use). Return WC_HW_E with a message like 'crypto2dev: pool not initialized (cleanup called?)' when slots == NULL.
